description: Install Chainlit + LlamaIndex (Ollama) in a venv on the remote and run the chat app bound to 127.0.0.1:8000 (Chainlit binds loopback by default). Open it over the tunnel.

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Pull the chat model with Ollama (skipped if present).
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1 && ollama pull llama3.1 || echo "Ollama CLI not found — install the AI Chat plugin first."

steps.description: Create a venv and install Chainlit + LlamaIndex Ollama (no root).
steps.run: set -e; mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit"; python3 -m venv "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit/venv"; "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit/venv/bin/pip" install -U pip; "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit/venv/bin/pip" install chainlit llama-index-llms-ollama

mkdir -p "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit"; cat > "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit/app.py" <<'PYEOF'
import chainlit as cl
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama

llm = Ollama(model="llama3.1", base_url="http://127.0.0.1:11434", request_timeout=120.0)

@cl.on_message
async def main(message: cl.Message):
    resp = await cl.make_async(llm.complete)(message.content)
    await cl.Message(content=str(resp)).send()
PYEOF

steps.description: Start Chainlit bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8000 (headless) and wait for it.
steps.run: cd "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit"; nohup "$HOME/.mobilessh/chainlit/venv/bin/chainlit" run app.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --headless >/tmp/chainlit.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Chainlit still starting — open it in a moment.";
